title: Deploy a Durable Object namespace with a migration record
asA: operator deploying a Worker that mints a Durable Object namespace
iWant: the wrangler configuration and migration record to be consistent with the platform's minting rules
soThat: the deploy succeeds and the namespace mints on the current backend

acceptanceCriteria.description: The migration record carries the new_sqlite_classes keyword against every minted class name.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a Worker configuration with a Durable Object binding block
acceptanceCriteria.then: the migration record uses the vendor-current keyword and the deploy succeeds

acceptanceCriteria.description: The wrangler binding names commit to the project's chosen class names on both binding blocks.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a Worker configuration with a Durable Object binding block
acceptanceCriteria.when: the applying agent has substituted the project's chosen class names
acceptanceCriteria.then: each binding's class_name appears once in the migration record
